text:
tess: Heads up — I kicked off a small targeted backfill for the KV aggregates in eu-west this morning, but the sidecar routing policy bumped a few jobs into the low-priority lane and we saw preemptions.

omar: Ugh, saw the alerts. Which backfill id?

tess: backfill-id: bf_eu_2026_03_21_01. It's a 3-hour window recompute for user_agg hours. Started at 07:10 UTC.

ben: Quick question: are we using the new sidecar-aware quota routing or the legacy per-tenant slot allocator for that run?

maya: It was supposed to use sidecar-aware routing (config: routing.sidecar_v2=true) per the dryrun flag in the operator UI. I verified before start.

omar: I pulled operator logs — sidecar gave the run a low weight because the tenant's recent usage breached the burst_threshold. That triggered the preemptible lane.

ben: Can you paste the snippet from the operator UI config? I want to confirm the burst thresholds.

maya: Sure: ```json
{"tenant_id":"acme","routing":{"policy":"sidecar_v2","burst_threshold":0.6,"fair_share_weight":1.0},"quota_window":"1h"}```

ben: Hmm that burst_threshold is correct but I think the console dryrun didn't persist the override for dedicated runs. There's a bug where console toggles don't propagate to the scheduler for reprocess jobs.

omar: That matches: deploy-bot.log shows a missing tag: `x-replay-override=true` not present. The scheduler fell back to default fairness.

maya: Is that a console->api thing or console->sidecar event propagation?

ben: Console->controlplane API call succeeded, but the controlplane didn't forward the tag to the sidecar when we used the "start from operator" path. Start path uses /api/recompute/operator -> controlplane -> scheduler; the tag was dropped in scheduler middleware.

omar: Proposed quick mitigation: add a scheduler middleware shim to copy `replay_override` to `routing_tags` for any operator-originated runs. Patch should be small.

maya: Agreed. Can we patch and restart scheduler without disrupting other backfills? We have ongoing runs in us-east too.

ben: Yes, rolling restart of scheduler replicas fine. I'll open a tiny PR. But we also need to mitigate current bf_eu... run — some jobs already evicted and requeued into the tail; that will slow window catchup and blow cost.

omar: Short-term operator action: bump the backfill priority in console to "operator-override" which sets QoS to high for the job. That should force scheduler to keep workers.

tess: I'm on it. Updating console priority now.

deploy-bot: deploy request: scheduler/patch-1723 queued by ben. CI passed. Ready to rollout.

ben: I'll wait 30s for the priority toggle to take effect and then roll the scheduler patch to ensure new operator runs keep the tag.

maya: Also worth adding a telemetry metric: `recompute.routing_tag_drops` with label origin={console,operator}. If we instrument, we'll catch this earlier.

omar: Agreed. Add an alert: rate(recompute.routing_tag_drops[5m]) > 0 -> p2. We should treat tag drops as a routing integrity incident.

tess: After priority bump + patch, the evicted shards started rescheduling. Progress on bf_eu... jumped from 34% -> 59% in 12m.

ben: PR merged and patched on two scheduler replicas; rolling restart in progress.

maya: Follow-up action items: 1) Add unit test for tag propagation in scheduler middleware. 2) Console dryrun UX: show whether operator path will persist overrides. 3) Telemetry metric + alert as Omar suggested.

omar: I'll file the alert runbook. Tess — can you paste a short note in the backfill run ticket with timeline and the operator priority toggle?

tess: Done. Ticket updated: notes include timestamps and before/after progress percentages.

ben: Nice work. We should also audit existing reprocess jobs for other dropped tags — I'll kick a query against events.replay_events where event_type="start" and routing_tags is null despite origin="operator".

maya: If that query returns >5 results across last 7 days, we escalate to platform-sla.

deploy-bot: alert: scheduler rolling-restart completed. 0 failed pods.

tess: Final status: bf_eu... completed at 09:28 UTC, total tokens recomputed ~1.2m, cost estimate within expected delta. Closing thread once we verify downstream dashboards refresh.

omar: I'll watch the console dashboards for staleness. If aggregates don't show updated values by +45m, reopen.

ben: Thanks team. Follow-ups tracked in JIRA: PLAT-4423 (scheduler tag fix), PLAT-4424 (console UX), PLAT-4425 (telemetry + alert).

maya: :thumbsup:
